title: Illinois Jacquet, Flying Home and the Royal Suite trumpeter
summary: Jacquet backs out of a Columbia date built around him; the cousin Phil Williams; Roy Eldridge changes his mind about the Royal Suite.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums
